facts.text: The hotel is mere steps from the historic Water Tower and Michigan Avenue.
facts.excerpt: Mere steps from the historic Water Tower and iconic Michigan Avenue, Park Hyatt Chicago captures the essence of luxury hotel living in downtown Chicago.

facts.text: The hotel is set in Chicago's historic Gold Coast.
facts.excerpt: Set in the historic Gold Coast, our luxury hotel places you moments from the best of downtown Chicago.

facts.text: The property opened in 1980 as the first Park Hyatt.
facts.excerpt: This property opened in 1980 as the first Park Hyatt, a brand conceived of by philanthropist and entrepreneur Jay Pritzker.

facts.text: The Water Tower is one of the only buildings to survive the 1871 Great Chicago Fire.

facts.text: The hotel has a three-lane lap pool on its 7th floor with views of the downtown Chicago cityscape.
facts.excerpt: Our three-lane, 25-yard lap pool sits on the hotel’s 7th floor with views of the downtown Chicago cityscape.

facts.text: There is no lifeguard on duty at the pool, and children 16 or younger must be accompanied by an adult.
facts.excerpt: Please note: No lifeguard on duty; children 16 or younger must be accompanied by an adult.

facts.text: NoMI Kitchen serves modern American cuisine rooted in French techniques.
facts.excerpt: Experience modern American cuisine rooted in French techniques at our onsite restaurant, NoMI Kitchen.

facts.excerpt: an open kitchen boasting a Molteni stove, mid-century furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Michigan Avenue

facts.text: NoMI Garden is an open-air rooftop terrace on the 7th floor.

facts.text: NoMI Garden is open during summer months.

facts.text: Champagne Row is limited to six seats at a time.
